channel_fit.reason: Clients search for a type of solicitor.

conversion_action.reason: 'Get in touch' form alongside 'Call us 0808 304 7471': the form wins the tie.

customer_type.reason: Mostly personal clients (conveyancing, family, injury, wills) with a business and commercial section.

geography.reason: Offices around Solihull and the West Midlands.

urgency.reason: Most matters are chosen over days; some family matters are urgent.

wins_by_tender.reason: Customers come to it directly; nothing on the site about tenders or frameworks.

draft.model_phrases_note: One phrase per practice area, real volume.

principal_activity: The principal activity of the Company in the year under review was that of a solicitor’s practice specialising in conveyancing, family law, private client, personal injury, dispute resolution and civil litigation work.
